I wrote the review report with verdict **fix**. The one real problem is that the new `/framework/ai/AISession/` page renders empty, with only the title and two tabs. It is 82–92% empty at every width, so it fails "show, don't tell". The page's `Doc` subject is the `AISession` class, but no class card or demo appears.

The five shimmed classes, the census doc and the architecture and patterns links all check out in the diff. The AI page's own layout is unchanged except for the added `AISession` child.

The other four findings are notes:
- **Tests and commits:** "tests green", the headless page opens and "one commit each" aren't visible in the diff or shots. Only the log line claims them.
- **Census naming:** ranks 12, 13 and 18 still say "name to confirm", and items 21–40 have no API.
- **Reachability:** the census page is reachable only from the patterns readme and a heading in the AI architecture doc.
- **Wrapping at 400px:** the two drawer-rail buttons wrap to 3.2 lines. The diff didn't cause that.

I read the diff and the shot sheet, not each page's individual width shots. `code/patterns/doc/oo-census.md` isn't in the main tree, so I judged the census from the diff alone. I made no code edits.

The report is `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/13/session-730e8a7b/mastermind-repo-slim/oo-census/review/report.md`.
